scope: Completed source runs only; no adaptation files, test inputs, model checkpoints, or new model forwards were read or executed.
accounting_binding_scope: The accounting.csv digest identifies the source-only snapshot read here; the shared accounting file can later be extended by adaptation aggregation. Source completions and per-run artifacts above are bound separately.
unique_input_interpretation: The same 8192 inputs are shared across all four conditions within each unit. Per-task and per-model unique counts must not be summed as distinct permutations.
timing_scope: Sum of recorded run intervals including source evaluations and periodic checkpoint work; not total end-to-end setup or all process overhead.

common_task_paired_differences.interpretation: Paired descriptive source-learning differences, not causal mediation estimates
